string.name: copy_number
string.comment: Menu action that copies a phone number to the clipboard.

string.name: create_new_contact
string.comment: Menu action that creates a contact from the selected phone number.

string.name: add_to_a_contact
string.comment: Menu action that adds the selected phone number to an existing contact.

string.name: send_message
string.comment: Menu action that starts a text message to the selected phone number.

string.name: edit_number_before_call
string.comment: Menu action that lets the user edit a phone number before calling it.

string.name: turn_on
string.comment: Button that opens settings to grant the permission required by the current screen.

string.name: placeholder_search_permissions
string.comment: Empty-state message shown when phone permission is required for dialpad suggestions.

resources.string: Slå på telefontillatelser for å se forslag

string.name: dialpad_button_call_label
string.comment: Accessibility label for the dialpad button that calls the entered number.

string.name: dialpad_more_options
string.comment: Accessibility label for the dialpad overflow menu.

string.name: add_2_second_pause
string.comment: Dialpad menu action that inserts a two-second pause into the phone number.

string.name: add_wait
string.comment: Dialpad menu action that inserts a wait-for-confirmation marker into the phone number.

string.name: call_contact
string.comment: Action that calls the selected contact.

string.name: open_contact
string.comment: Menu action that opens the selected person's contact details.

string.name: suggested
string.comment: Heading above contacts suggested for the entered phone number.

string.name: contact_history
string.comment: Action that opens the selected contact's call history.

string.name: backspace
string.comment: Accessibility label for deleting the last dialpad character.
